The applicant is an accused in a case under Sections 147, 452, 376(D), 354, 354(Kha), 504, 506 IPC, 3(1)(Da), 3(1)(Dha), 3(2)(va) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 (Amendment 2015), and 5(g)(6) of the Protection of Children form Sexual Offences Act.
